title: English-focused reliability baseline (read-only, captured before any Phase 7 change)
purpose: Freeze the pre-Phase-7 state so any later Phase 7 result can be compared against it. No production file was modified to produce this document.

environment.cpu: AMD Ryzen 9 8940HX with Radeon Graphics, 16 cores / 32 logical
environment.inference_backend: CPU only. whisper.cpp build-shared/CMakeCache.txt: GGML_CUDA=BOOL=OFF, GGML_VULKAN=BOOL=OFF, GGML_BLAS=BOOL=OFF, CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release. Relay log confirms 'no GPU found'.
environment.engine: relays/engines/parakeet_native_engine.py ParakeetNativeEngine -- model loaded once at relay start, single-worker ThreadPoolExecutor (thread affinity) + asyncio.Lock serializing calls

relays_before_phase7.skip: tests/test_engines.py::test_parakeet_engine_real_transcription -- parakeet-cli subprocess binary not built (subprocess fallback engine unused)

unchanged_historical_artifacts.note: md5 captured at Phase 7 start and re-verified at Phase 7 end; these files must not be rewritten by this phase.

benchmarks/results/svarah_phase4_rescore.role: Phase 4 policy rescore of the same run

benchmarks/results/phase5_flush_diag.jso.role: Phase 5 diagnostics; Phase 5 relay (PID 67396, started 2026-11-07 18:03:30) still owns it and still runs on :8768. Phase 7 never appends to it.

english_corpus_for_wer.audio: 16 kHz mono PCM16, all files present
english_corpus_for_wer.reference_availability: 60 of 60 non-empty references. Source: Svarah's own transcripts (original text preserved in meta.notes.svarah_text_original). Independent of Parakeet -- not a Parakeet draft and not a repeated Parakeet output, so WER is permitted for this corpus.
english_corpus_for_wer.excluded_corpus: dataset_existing (7 recordings, 250.5 min) has NO verified references -- WER must not be calculated or reported for it.
english_corpus_for_wer.wer_policy_note: Reference is one transcription of spontaneous speech; natural variation contributes to WER. Raw / number-normalized / compound-normalized WER are reported separately and none is called an accuracy score.

phase5_defect_state_carried_into_phase7.established: All five were Parakeet returning empty text for the exact utterance buffers; the relay dropped the empty result and sent no final (outcome dropped_empty_text).
phase5_defect_state_carried_into_phase7.phase6: Adding left context produced text for 4 of 5; kannada_00197 stayed empty even at 2 s of context. No single root cause established. Phase 6B deliberately skipped and not reopened.
phase5_defect_state_carried_into_phase7.why: No relay behaviour change is made in Phase 7 without approval; the behaviour is now pinned by tests instead.

phase7_relay.launcher: benchmarks/results/phase7/start_phase7_relay.py (imports parakeet_relay and overrides LISTEN_PORT before main(); no production file edited)
phase7_relay.reason: Phase 5 relay keeps :8768 and phase5_flush_diag.jsonl untouched
